page.overview:
Who is Agitha?

Agitha is a young, self-proclaimed princess around the age of 10 — part of The Legend of Zelda.

She lives in her Castle in Castle Town. She loves to dress in lolita fashion-style clothes and pretends to be a princess of the insect kingdom in her own little castle. There are twelve types of bugs, each species having both a male and female for 24 bugs total.
